info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Data Update API allows clients to modify existing financial market research data based on specified parameters. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions and analysts who need to enhance or correct market insights by updating relevant information. Users can provide a unique identifier to access and patch specific market data records efficiently. Ideal use cases include correcting inaccuracies or adjusting analytical inputs in dynamic market conditions.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the specified financial market research resource identified by the given ID. Ensure to provide the necessary data in the request body to make the desired changes.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the financial market research data identified by RES-100045. This may include various fields related to market analysis, reports, and other financial data relevant to the specified research ID.
